summary: test searches text for a regular-expression match and returns a Boolean.
documentation: test searches text for a regular-expression match and returns a Boolean. Anchors can constrain a pattern, while global and sticky expressions keep state through lastIndex between calls.
inputs: A string to test against a regular expression.
returns: True when a match is found, otherwise false.
caution: Avoid a global flag for independent validation. The $ anchor can match before a final line break, so enforce the full input length for this fixed-width format.
scenarios: Validate the documented shape of an internal reference.
Check a local form field before displaying a preview.
Classify an imported code by an explicitly defined pattern.
title: Check a fixed invoice reference
problem: Input is a string. Return true only for exactly INV- followed by exactly three ASCII digits, with no extra characters or line breaks. Case matters.
goal: Use RegExp.test() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Combine a non-global anchored pattern with an exact length of seven.
